title: The Old Cellar
text: Under the hull, a hatch. It was sealed from the inside, then welded again from the outside, in a different hand. The drones cut it. Below: bunks for twenty, a water still, a wall of tally marks, and a plate of hull alloy scratched with a map.

lines.text: "They were hiding down there. From what?"

lines.speaker: Scratched on the plate
lines.text: "IT KNOWS THE DOORS. GO DOWN. GO DEEP."
"The map's a crater. South-west, a long way off, with a cut marked in its rim. Someone wanted the next ones to find it."
